cleansingStrength.rationale: Moderate by C1: defining anionic Sodium C14-16 Olefin Sulfonate @2 (ether/sulfonate type), prominent buffer Cocamidopropyl Betaine @3, no reinforcing strong anionic. Cocamide DIPA @4 is an alkanolamide (not a route, not a buffer).

conditioningLevel.rationale: Moderate: several light routes, all after Parfum @9 (not prominent): Butyrospermum Parkii Butter @10, Polyester-37 @11, Glycol Distearate @13, Guar Hydroxypropyltrimonium Chloride @15, Polyquaternium-39 @19, with Glycerin @5 and Panthenol @14. C2 not met: no prominent silicone and no prominent payload lipid (shea is after the E3 point). Because every conditioning route is post-E3, low is the realistic neighbor.
conditioningLevel.counterSignal: Every conditioning route is after Parfum @9.
